description: Spreads a polyphonic output evenly between two voltages, giving the first channel the start voltage and the last channel the end voltage

params.text: Sets how many channels the output carries, 2 to 16
Sets the voltage the first channel carries, -10V to 10V
Scales the start voltage input before it is added to the start knob, -1 to 1
Sets the voltage the last channel carries, -10V to 10V
Scales the end voltage input before it is added to the end knob, -1 to 1

inputs.text: Moves the start voltage through its own trimpot; it is read only while a cable is patched here, and only its first channel is used
Moves the end voltage through its own trimpot; it is read only while a cable is patched here, and only its first channel is used

outputs.text: The step from one channel of the range to the next, which is the end voltage less the start voltage divided by one less than the channel count
The range itself, a polyphonic signal running in even steps from the start voltage to the end voltage

notes: the two end voltages are always included, so the step shrinks as the channel count grows; with the start and end at the same voltage every channel carries that voltage and the step is 0V

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
